title: Precision for Joint-Complier Effects in Factorial Encouragement Designs with Few Compliers

tldr:
An exact six-count latent-allocation experiment and quantitative labeled-record converse give sharp fixed-composition oracle precision under independent Bernoulli factorial assignment. With one joint complier, the complete connected-length confidence frontier is
\[
 \lim_{B\to\infty}H_\alpha(1,B)
 =\mathfrak h(1-\alpha)=\left(3(1-\alpha)-\frac54\right)_+.
\]
Its sole coverage transition is \(5/12\): zero-length randomized singleton rules are already honest below and at that level, for every finite \(B\). An explicit unrestricted primal and dual prove the frontier, and
\[
 0\leq\mathfrak h(1-\alpha)-H_\alpha(1,B)
 \leq\frac{\rho_B}{4}\leq\frac1{2\sqrt{B+1}}
\]
holds for all confidence levels, including the transition. Equalizing conditional coverage across targets would incorrectly introduce transitions at \(3/8\) and \(1/2\); a legal singleton witness refutes that restriction as a reduction of the declared information class.

At \(90\%\), the limiting length remains \(29/20\), with matching saturation-gap order \(\Theta((B+1)^{-1/2})\); the nuisance-uniform improved interval has exactly \(90\%\) coverage and length \(29/20-\beta(B)/60\) in every fixed response state. Squared risk increases strictly at every one-joint contamination count, tends to \(3/4\), and has gap order \(\Theta((B+1)^{-1})\). Exact first values are \(R(1,0)=1/2\), \(R(1,1)=481/768\), \(H_{1/10}(1,0)=6/5\), and \(H_{1/10}(1,1)=103/80\). In the broader nine-type monotone Bernoulli class without supplied margins, a separate full-record result gives asymptotic values \(1\) and \(2(1-\alpha)\), with constant-procedure gap upper bounds \(O(n^{-1})\) for squared risk and \(O(n^{-1/4})\) for length. Oracle counts are optimistic sensitivity and planning inputs, not observed GOTV compliance margins.
gap: Blackwell (2017) identifies the target effect. Regular finite-population factorial IV results, exact CACE intervals, and Blackwell--Pashley (2024) partial-identification bounds do not characterize conditional unrestricted full-record precision when rare joint-type counts stay fixed. Generic finite minimax games are established machinery.
fill: At each correctly indexed composition, quantitative nuisance-record reconstruction yields sharp oracle benchmark functions and limiting decision values over the full compatible schedule class. Separate MSE and honest connected-length optimizations give attaining procedures and rational small-case certificates. The GOTV contrast motivates planning sensitivity curves and unknown-margin difficulty lower bounds, rather than data-implementable interval guarantees. Unknown margins and validity across several indices are outside scope.
